text.p: Malaysia's Metroplex Bhd said on Wednesday its proposed listing of a new investment holding company has been submitted to the Securities Commission.
The listing of RDC Consolidated Bhd is part of a restructuring exercise in the group.
Metroplex said in a statement that RDC would concentrate on property development allowing Metroplex to focus on expanding its hotel and leisure activities in the Asian-Pacific region.

Under the restructuring, RDC would acquire four of Metroplex's property development subsidiaries and six privately owned companies for 428.18 million ringgit to be satisfied by an issue of 186.17 million new RDC shares priced at 2.30 ringgit per share.
For the listing exercise, RDC proposed to issue 11.37 million shares, and the controlling shareholders would offer for sale 2.17 million RDC shares to the public at a price to be determined later.
